name: Trackhop
description: Trackhop keeps your playlists in sync between music services (Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex, Last.fm and more), one way or both ways, on a schedule, from a web page on your server. Open source, in beta.
seoDescription: Sync playlists between Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Navidrome, Jellyfin and more. Deploy Trackhop on Dokploy: free, open source, self-hosted.
